endpoints: POST https://search-kyrok9udlk.gapcommerceapi.com/product/search  headers: entity-id=<store uuid>, org-id, x-api-key (public key embedded in the page; value not recorded), content-type json. Body: {from,size,query:{bool:{must:[range customMinPrice 0.2..500000, isAboveThreshold true, isHideFromMenu false]}},collapse:{field:'catalogParentId',inner_hits:{name:'siblings',size:5,_source:[...]}}} (the UI form; size 10 or 20) plus aggs facets/productsCount
POST same URL, body with customProductGroups match, size 300 (promotion product groups)
GET https://www.stashdispensaries.com/shop?returnUrl=%2Fshop&page=N (and ?_rsc=... prefetches for every product link on the page)
data_loading.notes: This POST URL is already in backend/network.py _READ_ONLY_SEARCH_POSTS with headers entity-id/org-id/x-api-key (it was added for exactly this host). The UI query is COLLAPSED by catalogParentId with sibling inner_hits capped at 5 per group, hence the adapter's detail-page expansion. Replaying the POST in page context WITHOUT collapse (size 100, sort [{_id:'asc'}]) returned every variant with productData (pricing/discounts/inventory), customSize, amount, unitOfMeasurement, category, subtype, brand, isAboveThreshold; sorts on id.keyword fail (no mapping) and no sort / '_doc' give unstable pages (duplicates). size=1000 failed at the network level, so keep size <= 100.

paging: Observed UI: 'Showing 1-20 of 1362 results' (collapsed parents, aggregation productsCount 1363), ~69 pages of 20. Uncollapsed raw hits.total = 1425-1426 (relation eq; drifts by a few between reads - the pipeline once observed 1437 variants). Direct replay: from=0..1400 step 100 with sort [{_id:'asc'}] -> 15 requests, 1426 unique ids = hits.total 1426 (exact). Without a sort the same 15 pages produce only 1380 unique (score ties) so the sort is mandatory.

why_it_fails: Resolution is right; the traversal is the problem. providers/treez.py fetch() walks the catalog through the browser UI: it follows 'Go to next page' links over ~69 pages of 20 collapsed parents, expands every group whose sibling inner_hits are truncated (>5 variants) by opening product detail pages, and needs 2-3 verification passes (verification_passes=3) of unchanged counts. Each Next.js page triggers many RSC prefetch fetches, so the 4000-response browser capture budget (see docs/PHASE3_PHILI_EXPERIMENT.md / browser_render) is exhausted after about 1437 variants, ending as partial grade C. Even without the budget, the raw total drifts (1425 vs 1426 vs 1437 observed) while paging, so the 'count_complete and unchanged fingerprint' rule is hard to satisfy on a 69-page walk.
fix_idea: Shared Treez fix: after the single browser render that clears the age gate and picks the store, capture the search POST's headers (entity-id, org-id, x-api-key) and replay the allowlisted POST from the page context with an uncollapsed body (same must-filters, no collapse), size 100, sort [{_id:'asc'}] and from stepping by 100: ~15 requests, deterministic, siblings come back as separate hits so no detail-page expansion. Reconcile unique ids against hits.total (relation 'eq') on two passes. Keeps the existing normalize() (it already reads productData.pricing/discounts/inventory). Applies to every store on the Stash org (Peru, Orland Hills) and any other Treez Ecommerce site using gapcommerceapi.com. Also consider reducing prefetch noise by blocking _rsc requests in the browser worker for treez endpoints.
